body:
emit-params used to hard-code EVERY param's own C type as Arena *
regardless of its real declared type -- already flagged as a known,
narrow v0 gap in this file's own prior header comment. Concretely
wrong for selfhost/lexer.prn's own real new-lexer function, whose
single param is String-typed, not Arena-typed.

Fixed with two new helpers: param-type-name reads a param's own
type-name symbol (confirmed live via a real AST dump that
`(name : Type @ ...)` always parses with the type symbol at child
index 2), param-c-type maps String -> char *, I32 -> int, anything
else falls back to the prior universal Arena * behavior (an honest,
narrow v0 boundary, not a claim of covering every real param shape).
Only an Arena-typed param is still added to the ArenaBinding scope --
resolve-arena-ref's own None case already falls back to a bare
mangled name for anything else, exactly correct. Also fixed the same
already-documented "inline get-field on a bare vec/get call" compile
gap along the way.

7 new assertions (20 total for domain 4): a real String param -> char
*, a real I32 param -> int, and a zero-regression check that an Arena
param still gets Arena * and is still correctly scoped (an alloc call
referencing it still resolves bare, no stray &). Full local suite
(336 tests) + all 5 selfhost domains + real mingw cross-compile
clean, zero regressions. CI green on all 4 jobs, confirmed via the
Actions API.

Honest note, re-checked against the same self-compile diagnostic used
to find the prior crash: selfhost/lexer.prn's own real error count is
UNCHANGED by this fix -- still dominated by 35 #error instances for
unsupported non-alloc let-binding shapes (real function calls used as
let values), plus a real, separate, not-yet-diagnosed class of
undeclared-identifier errors. This closes a real, independently-
confirmed type-correctness bug on its own merits, not a claim of
moving lexer.prn closer to actually compiling. NORTHSTAR.md's own
"Self-hosting" section updated with the full writeup, naming the
dominant remaining blocker as the next, much larger step.

PARENA commit 2e4bfc0. CI run 33097619247: all 4 jobs green.
